fact_text: Pakistan has lifted its ban on commercial import of used cars, which the dealers' association chairman said was done at the IMF's urging.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The age condition on used-car imports is due to end in July 2026, after which cars 7 years old, 10 years old or older can be imported.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Commercial used-car imports must be made by a company registered under the Finance Act 2017, and the car must have no major accident and an intact windshield.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The overseas Pakistani gift and baggage scheme brought about 400 used cars in FY25, with about $500 million of duties and taxes paid, according to the dealers' chairman.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The budget removed a 40% regulatory duty on cars above 1800cc, which the dealers' chairman said benefited luxury buyers rather than those who needed the relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Assemblers say taxes make up 30-35% of a locally assembled car's price, which they cite as the reason they cannot sell cheaper.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman said Toyota, Honda and Suzuki employ fewer than 5,000 people directly, with most of their workers hired through vendors on daily wages.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Vendors say about PKR 1.5 million of locally made parts goes into each assembled car, which they say makes commercial used-car imports a threat to local jobs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Karachi alone has more than 7,000 spare-parts importers and sellers and over 11,000 workshops, which dealers said would be hurt if used-car imports expand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Some imported spare parts take three to four months to arrive, which the reporter raised as a service problem for used-car buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: A 1984 agreement tied to Suzuki's Pakistan venture, called a deletion programme, was meant to bring technology transfer and local manufacturing within four to five years, which the dealers' chairman said did not happen.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman argued that the big assemblers have stayed assemblers for about 40 years rather than moving to manufacturing and localisation, which he said keeps taxes high.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Duties and taxes on gift-scheme cars are paid in dollars, which the dealers' chairman said shows the scheme is not a channel for passport misuse.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman estimated commercial used-car imports would need about $1 billion of foreign exchange and questioned where the government would find it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman said the Prime Minister's office has directed the commerce ministry to consult dealers on the used-car import rules.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman asked the government to keep the gift-scheme import route unchanged and to soften the conditions on commercial used-car imports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: The dealers' chairman said Pakistani car prices are far above those of the same models in a neighbouring country, which he blamed on taxes and assembler margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)

fact_text: Dealers said a large share of car sales still happen at black-market premiums above list price, because buyers cannot get locally assembled cars without paying extra.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Importing Used Cars: Is Pakistan's Latest Decision A Boon or A Bane? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-29)
